objective: Measure the production Gemini reader identity on the 28 AncientDoc development pages as loose full-page transcription, then test whether a geometry-grounded agentic adjudicator that sees the page, the RF-DETR box overlay, the column structure, and the transcription can correctly certify boxes, flag untrustworthy transcriptions, and route pages between full-page and column-mode reading.
hypothesis: The production Gemini reader identity avoids the catastrophic repetition observed in PaddleOCR-VL and Kimi-VL on most AncientDoc pages, and the adjudicator's route_recommendation identifies every page whose transcription CER is catastrophic (>= 1.0) without rejecting most healthy pages.

reader.transport_deviation: Production resolves ${PALIMPSEST_MODEL_READING} to google/gemini-3.6-flash through the OMP provider lane; this experiment calls the same model directly through the Gemini API provider, the established pattern for fixed-model development candidates.
reader.scope_deviation: Primary reader only: the production dual-reader (secondary gpt-5.6-sol) and text-only adjudication are out of scope; this experiment replaces them with the geometry-grounded adjudicator under test.
reader.system_prompt: You are an expert paleographer transcribing digitized manuscript pages.

inputs: deterministic column structure JSON with per-column box counts
adjudicator.output_schema: boxes_verdict, transcription_verdict, count_fit, route_recommendation, column_notes, reasoning
adjudicator.gold_isolation: The adjudicator never sees development gold; its verdicts are evaluated against gold-derived CER only after all calls complete.

geometry.production_note: Production align pins the older rfdetr-mth600/v1 checkpoint; this experiment uses the newer mth2156 development checkpoint already audited on the MTHv2 official test.
geometry.column_rule: sorted x-center gap splitting at 0.45 of median box width within y-gap registers

gates.transcription_ratio_alarm: Stop before adjudication if more than 8 pages have non-space output/box-count ratio outside [0.6, 1.5].
gates.adjudicator_success: Every page with CER >= 1.0 receives column_mode or reject_both, and at most 2 pages with CER <= 0.3 are routed away from accept_full_page.
gates.budget_stop: Runner refuses the next paid call once observed spend reaches the declared maximum.

non_goals: Do not edit the production recipe.
Do not run the production dual-reader or OMP transport.
Do not promote or propose any candidate from this evidence.
next_permitted_action: Run the two-case transcription smoke, verify per-call cost, then complete all 28 transcriptions and 28 adjudications within the declared budget.
